text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear claim that self-controlled cars should be brought into our lives","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position more directly and consistently, so the reader knows early what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"Paragraphs on safety, convenience, and accident reduction","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its points into separate body paragraphs that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Uses half a million miles without a crash and driver alerts","quality":"source-based support","description":"The essay relies more clearly on details from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"Explains alerts, vibrating seats, and driver takeover","quality":"development of evidence","description":"The essay does more to explain how the article’s examples support its position rather than just naming them."},{"evidence":"“Well guess what!” “How awesome is that!” “Lets go driverless cars!”","quality":"voice","description":"The essay has a more energetic, persuasive tone that helps the argument feel forceful."},{"evidence":"“so what’s the difference?” and “The problem is…”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay more directly acknowledges possible concerns and tries to dismiss them."}]}
